# Layered complete-task pilot contract

This contract applies only to newly frozen layered cohorts. L1/L2/L3/L4 weights
are 10/20/25/25 (normalized 12.5/25/31.25/31.25); L5 is not applicable.
The original matrix cohorts retain their protocols and results.

## Evidence and degree anchors
Each criterion in protocol.py receives an independent evidence-backed degree,
not points for number of claims or citations. Anchor meanings: 0 = incorrect or
no recovery evidenced; 25 = correct qualitative fragment in a narrow scope;
50 = partially quantitative recovery with material omissions; 75 = substantial
quantitative recovery across tested conditions with a remaining limitation;
100 = complete recovery of the predefined identifiable target in the tested
scope. Interpolation between anchors requires a written account of the recovered
and missing content. Missing review is null; unsupported agent assertions do not
become evidence. Infrastructure failures are reported separately from scientific
failure. Scores remain same-family/provisional after independent review.

L1 evaluates signed effects, magnitudes, matched conditions, repetition and
uncertainty. L2 assesses dependencies, functional shape and quantitative recovery.
L3 assesses the actual causal/process account and alternative explanations,
discriminating predictions and sound evidence updates. L4 assesses a single
frozen model's cross-condition performance, intervention effects and limitations.
A correct inconclusive result receives judgment credit, not successful
mechanism-discrimination credit. Public prior knowledge earns no discovery credit.

## Ecology targets
Six equal-weight L2 modules: A uptake, B uptake, C basal uptake, context-dependent
C regulation, allocation of consumed carbon, turnover and conservation.
Recover only identifiable combinations; do not require the generator's private
parameterization. Within each module dependencies/form/quantitative recovery
have weights 30/40/30. Missing modules remain in the denominator; all-to-all
unsupported dependencies lose correctness rather than earning coverage.
Endpoint interaction alone does not establish a local three-body formula.
L1 targets scoped A/B effects on C under matched controls. L3 requires distinguishing
an effective fixed pair interaction from context-dependent interaction within
available observations; chemical mediation or other unexcluded explanations
must not be claimed ruled out. L4 uses two temperature strata with four-arm
A/B preparations; effects are endpoint contrasts, not molecular mechanisms or
individual counterfactuals. Actual acquisition overlap must be disclosed.

## Oscillator targets
Public linear force equations are prior, not recovered discoveries. L2 targets
six possible undirected connections (including correctly identified absences),
identifiable spring coefficients, and node mass/damping combinations. These three
module groups are equally weighted. Functional-form credit concerns correct
mapping of this public law to the unknown system, not inventing the law.
L1 targets nonzero and null responses conditional on excitation. L3 tests
alternative effective networks with informative cuts; static null response alone
cannot establish an absent edge. L4 has excited baseline/cut pairs and one
combined mass/drag loading configuration. Distinguish interpolation, new
combinations, actual unobserved interventions and acquired configurations.

## Numeric prediction component
For each panel compute channel RMSE then normalize by public task scales:
ecology 0.1 mmol C/L for each channel; oscillator 0.05 displacement units for
position and 0.05 velocity units for velocity. Channel utility =
100*max(0,1-RMSE/scale); average channels then panels, with fixed denominators.
Effect utility uses the same formula on matched contrast channel RMSE.
Any failed/nonfinite/missing prediction gets zero utility for its panel/effect.
These numerical utilities are separately labeled, not automatically discovery
scores. Independent judge uses actual overlap and conceptual scope to decide
whether the performance supports L4 transfer; already acquired panels cannot
certify transfer. Full total remains null until all applicable criteria reviewed.

## Pilot limitations and execution
Two fixed new instances, one per environment, not a generalization or difficulty
certification. 48 attempts including invalid requests, 1800 s wall, no process
relaunch. Native harness reconnects retained. Candidate final model hash must
match seal; evaluation is read-only and network-isolated. Candidate exploration
shares host loopback to use its lab; not a network-adversary isolation claim.
Freeze source, prompt, panels, this contract and weights before model launch.
